x-plume::accordion.description: Collapsible content panels for saving vertical space.

x-plume::accordion.item.description: An individual collapsible item within an accordion.

x-plume::alert.description: Displays a callout for user attention.
x-plume::alert.usage:
<x-plume::alert style="success" title="Success" closable autoclose="3000">
    Your changes have been saved.
</x-plume::alert>

x-plume::aspect.description: A container component to maintain consistent proportions for media and content.

x-plume::audio.description: A styled wrapper for HTML5 audio content.

x-plume::avatar.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

x-plume::badge.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

x-plume::breadcrumb.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

x-plume::button.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

x-plume::button.loader.description: Button with built-in loading state management.

x-plume::button.toggle.description: Button that toggles between two states.

x-plume::card.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

x-plume::code.description: A component for displaying code snippets with a copy-to-clipboard feature.

x-plume::command.description: A powerful search and action interface accessible via keyboard shortcuts.

x-plume::data-table.description: Advanced table with sorting, filtering, and pagination. Powered by AlpineJS.

x-plume::divider.description: Visually separates content sections with an optional label.

x-plume::drawer.description: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.

x-plume::dropdown.description: Displays a menu to the user—such as a set of actions or functions—triggered by a button.

x-plume::empty-state.description: Use this component to show a placeholder when a list or page has no data.
x-plume::empty-state.usage:
<x-plume::empty-state 
    title="No items found" 
    description="Get started by creating your first item."
/>

x-plume::figure.description: Enhanced image component with captions and aspect ratio control.

x-plume::form.description: A collection of form components for user input.

x-plume::form.input.description: Standard text input fields, including password and number variants.

x-plume::gallery.description: Responsive grid layout for images and figures.

x-plume::modal.description: A dialog box or popup window that is displayed on top of the current page.

x-plume::progress.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.

x-plume::stepper.usage:

    <x-plume::stepper.step step="1" title="Account" next />

</x-plume::stepper>

x-plume::stepper.actions.description: Standard actions layout for stepper components.

x-plume::toaster.description: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.
